$comment: Per-symbol triage of every scorer false positive, verified individually
against source. Each entry cites the cfg evidence that justifies it.
HOST-DEPENDENT: this index was produced by rust-analyzer on macOS/aarch64,
so items gated for other platforms are absent from the golden while loregrep,
which parses syntax rather than compiling, sees all of them. Regenerating the
index on Linux WILL make some of these stale - that is the ratchet working,
not a failure. Re-triage rather than deleting wholesale.

Entries are only for symbols in files the ORACLE DID index. When an entire file is outside the indexer's projects, the scorer's structural `outside_oracle_scope` guard classifies it — that is a better statement than a per-symbol waiver, so such entries were removed here rather than kept (they surfaced automatically as STALE when the guard landed).
